title: pentaschistis aurea subsp. pilosogluma
intro: Pentaschistis aurea subsp. pilosogluma, commonly known as Golden Leptinella, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a native South African plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Golden Leptinella include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
